experiences.name: Zermatt Ski Safari
experiences.description: Explore the world-class ski slopes of Zermatt with access to over 360km of groomed pistes. Ski beneath the iconic Matterhorn with breathtaking panoramic views. Suitable for intermediate to advanced skiers with varied terrain including moguls, powder fields, and long cruising runs.

experiences.name: Jungfrau Region Snowshoeing & Winter Hiking
experiences.description: Guided snowshoe trek through pristine alpine landscapes around the Jungfrau region, passing frozen lakes and snow-draped pine forests. Reach elevated viewpoints overlooking the Eiger, Mönch, and Jungfrau peaks. Includes equipment rental and a warm raclette lunch at a mountain hut.

experiences.name: Davos Ice Skating & Curling Experience
experiences.description: Skate on the largest natural ice rink in Europe at Davos and try your hand at traditional Swiss curling with a local instructor. A quintessential alpine winter experience combining sport and Swiss cultural tradition, followed by hot chocolate at a lakeside café.

experiences.name: St. Moritz Toboggan Run on the Cresta Run
experiences.description: Experience the legendary Cresta Run, one of the world's oldest and most thrilling natural ice toboggan tracks. Descend at speeds up to 130 km/h on a 1.2km track carved through the mountain. Includes safety briefing, equipment, and a commemorative certificate — a bucket-list alpine adventure.

experiences.name: Swiss Alpine Fondue & Mountain Culture Evening
experiences.description: Join a traditional Swiss fondue dinner in a historic chalet restaurant, featuring local Gruyère and Appenzeller cheeses paired with regional white wine. Learn about Swiss alpine heritage, yodeling traditions, and the history of mountain communities from a local guide. A warm cultural immersion after a day on the slopes.
